title: ephemerantha trilamellata
intro: Ephemerantha trilamellata, commonly known as the "three-layered orchid," is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is believed to help with fever reduction, coughs, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Ephemerantha trilamellata include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antipyretic activities, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
